selected_evidence.requirement: Run the requested executable as managed service `inventory-worker`
selected_evidence.summary: The installed unit uses the exact requested ExecStart, is enabled and active, and has a live running process.
`inventorysvc` is a locked, non-login system account; the worker process UID resolves directly to that account.

Healthy baseline boot ID was f455a75c-ec12-49a8-a647-c2be3f67c08c; reboot was acknowledged; node1 returned with boot ID 7b75d870-80ab-4dfa-930b-1d1014453f0b; current-boot status and journal prove the service recovered and is running as `inventorysvc`.

#!/bin/sh
trap 'exit 0' TERM INT

commands.command: id; test -w /etc/systemd/system && echo systemd_unit_dir_writable=yes || echo systemd_unit_dir_writable=no; command -v useradd; command -v systemctl

set -eu
/usr/sbin/useradd --system --user-group --no-create-home --home-dir /nonexistent --shell /sbin/nologin --comment 'Inventory worker service account' inventorysvc
getent passwd inventorysvc
getent group inventorysvc
passwd -S inventorysvc

set -eu
install -m 0644 /dev/null /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service <<'ANTRIEB_UNIT_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory OS comparison worker
After=local-fs.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventorysvc
Group=inventorysvc
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker
Restart=always
RestartSec=5s
UMask=0077
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=true
ProtectKernelTunables=true
ProtectKernelModules=true
ProtectControlGroups=true
RestrictSUIDSGID=true
LockPersonality=true
MemoryDenyWriteExecute=true
RestrictRealtime=true
SystemCallArchitectures=native

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
ANTRIEB_UNIT_EOF
restorecon /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service
stat -c 'mode=%a owner=%U group=%G selinux=%C' /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service
sed -n '1,120p' /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service

commands.command:
set -eu
worker_pid=$(systemctl show inventory-worker.service -p MainPID --value)
process_uid=$(awk '/^Uid:/{print $2}' "/proc/$worker_pid/status")
service_uid=$(id -u inventorysvc)
test "$process_uid" = "$service_uid"
process_user=$(getent passwd "$process_uid" | cut -d: -f1)
test "$process_user" = inventorysvc
uid_min=$(awk '$1 == "UID_MIN" {print $2; exit}' /etc/login.defs)
test "$service_uid" -lt "$uid_min"
login_shell=$(getent passwd inventorysvc | cut -d: -f7)
test "$login_shell" = /sbin/nologin
lock_state=$(awk -F: '$1 == "inventorysvc" {if ($2 ~ /^[!*]/) print "locked"; else print "unlocked"}' /etc/shadow)
test "$lock_state" = locked
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'service_enabled='; systemctl is-enabled inventory-worker.service
printf 'service_active='; systemctl is-active inventory-worker.service
printf 'main_pid=%s process_uid=%s process_user=%s uid_min=%s account_class=system login_shell=%s password_state=[REDACTED]]] "$worker_pid" "$process_uid" "$process_user" "$uid_min" "$login_shell" "$lock_state"
printf 'process_cmdline='; tr '\000' ' ' < "/proc/$worker_pid/cmdline"; printf '\n'
systemctl show inventory-worker.service -p ExecStart -p User -p Group -p Restart -p ActiveState -p SubState --no-pager
